caveat: This is an exact, observational split between two independently-generated recorded runs. 'controlled' means only that the user-side prompt sequence matched under this diff's own contract -- it is never a causal claim that a model/config change caused this specific token. The window shown around the divergence point is for orientation only: once two runs diverge they are continuing from different prefixes, so positions after the split are not independent comparisons.

a_considered_b.note: rank is 0-based within the target run's RECORDED alternatives at this position (the capture-time top-k list, which excludes the target's own committed token) -- NOT a full-vocabulary rank; 'found: false' means 'not in the recorded list', which is weaker than 'not close'.
